Timebox with a real wallet

Every step a user takes to put money in and to get it out again, at phone size, on a local copy of Ethereum mainnet. The wallet is vitalik.eth as it is on the chain: ETH, USDC, USDT, DAI, WETH, about ten other real tokens, and several hundred meme and spam tokens.

Put one asset in from the wallet31
